(Ag.) in Plant Breeding, Plant Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Genetics, or Plant Physiology, or a Postgraduate degree in Basic Science with NET qualification and two years of agricultural research experience (Ph.D. desirable) can attend the walk-in interview on 04 August 2026. content_sections.heading: ICAR CRRI Senior Rice Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
ICAR CRRI Senior Rice Research Fellow Selection Process 2026
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR CRRI Senior Research Fellow (SRF) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR CRRI SRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position at ICAR CRRI is scheduled for 04 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they attend on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.Sc. (Ag.) in specific specializations or a Post Graduate degree in Basic Science with NET qualification and research experience. A PhD is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post is 40 years. Age relaxations are applicable for SC, ST, and OBC candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000/- plus HRA as per the rules.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General, OBC, SC, ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the ICAR CRRI SRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Screening Test followed by a Written-cum-Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the ICAR CRRI office in Cuttack, Odisha.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position is a contractual job.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is 16/SRF/2026-27.
